palu.translation: [地名] [爱沙尼亚、土耳其、印度尼西亚] 帕卢

paludal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to marshes or fens; marshy.
paludal.translation:
a. 沼泽地的, 多沼泽的, 疟疾性的
[医] 沼泽的, 沼生的

paludamentum.definition:
n. A military cloak worn by a general and his principal
   officers.

paludicole.definition: a. Marsh-inhabiting; belonging to the Paludicolae
paludicole.translation: a. 居于沼泽的；在沼泽中出没的

paludina.definition:
n. Any one of numerous species of freshwater
   pectinibranchiate mollusks, belonging to Paludina, Melantho, and allied
   genera. They have an operculated shell which is usually green, often
   with brown bands. See Illust. of Pond snail, under Pond.

paludine.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a marsh.

paludism.definition:
n. The morbid phenomena produced by dwelling among marshes;
   malarial disease or disposition.

paludose.definition: a. Growing or living in marshy places; marshy.

paludrine.translation: n. [药]百乐君(合成抗疟药盐酸氯胍的商标名)

palus.definition:
n. One of several upright slender calcareous processes which
   surround the central part of the calicle of certain corals.

palustral.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a bog or marsh; boggy.
palustral.translation: a. 沼泽的, (鸟等)沼栖的, 沼生的

palustrine.definition:
a. Of, pertaining to, or living in, a marsh or swamp;
   marshy.

palustrol.translation: [化] 喇叭茶醇; 喇叭茶┤醇
